stem: Summit Retail separates customer checkout from dev sandbox environments and wants availability aligned to business impact. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Run customer checkout across multiple Availability Zones
Use smaller single-AZ or scheduled capacity for dev sandbox workloads
Route checkout and sandbox through one shared instance
Run checkout in one Availability Zone with larger instances
Keep both environments active-active across two Regions continuously

rationale: Multi-AZ deployment fits high-impact checkout availability targets, while lower-impact sandbox workloads can use smaller or scheduled capacity to control spend. Routing both environments through one instance creates a shared failure point. Running checkout in one Availability Zone, even on larger instances, still misses the production multi-AZ availability requirement. Two-Region active-active for both environments may be valid in special cases but is not a cost-aligned default for a dev sandbox.
